description: This file defines the LanguageService interface, which provides methods for managing Language entities, including fetching by code, retrieving all languages, converting between Language objects and Locale, and obtaining a map of languages.

classes.name: LanguageService
classes.description: An interface for language-related business logic operations in the application.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Language object based on its code, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getLanguagesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of language codes to Language objects, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Returns a list of all Language objects, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: toLocale
methods.description: Converts a Language object to a Locale object.

methods.name: toLanguage
methods.description: Converts a Locale object to a Language object.
